name: probatio
description: Mutation runner for AI agents. Scores a test suite by the bugs it catches.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/mutate && cp src/mutate/fail-reporter.mjs src/mutate/node-coverage.mjs src/mutate/precise-lines.mjs src/mutate/child-lines.mjs src/mutate/mocha-coverage.cjs src/mutate/node-batch.mjs src/mutate/node-batch-loader.mjs src/mutate/load-failure.mjs src/mutate/py-reporter.py src/mutate/py-pytest-reporter.py src/mutate/probatio-jacoco-run.java dist/mutate/ && mkdir -p dist/golden && cp src/golden/recorder.mjs dist/golden/
